summary: Create an Ansible Automation Platform Backup from Operators > Installed Operators > All Instances, giving a name and the deployment name; success shows AnsibleAutomationPlatformBackup, AutomationControllerBackup, EDABackup and AutomationHubBackup as Running or Successful.
questions: How do I back up AAP from the OpenShift console?
How do I check that an AAP backup succeeded?
What does deployment_name mean in the backup resource?

answer_card.title: Back up AAP on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md:
Operators > Installed Operators > AAP > *All Instances* > Create New > *Ansible Automation Platform Backup*:
```yaml
apiVersion: aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatformBackup
metadata:
  name: backup
  namespace: aap
spec:
  no_log: true
  deployment_name: aap
```
Check All Instances: AnsibleAutomationPlatformBackup, AutomationControllerBackup, EDABackup and AutomationHubBackup should be *Running* or *Successful*.
